title: Solo Leveling
summary: In a world where hunters battle deadly monsters, weak hunter Sung Jinwoo is chosen by a mysterious program.
review:
God-Tier Art & Pacing

Solo Leveling sets the modern standard for webtoons. DUBU's illustration style brings every fight scene to life with dynamic paneling and vibrant effects.

Key Highlights

  • Pacing: Fast-paced with constant progression.
  • Art: Top-tier character designs and shadow effects.
A must-read for anyone getting into modern webtoons.
